<h1>Currently Supported Plugins</h1>

* [[Depenizen/BattleNight|BattleNight]]
* Factions
* mcMMO
* Towny
* Votifier
* Jobs

If you would like another plugin to be supported, please [https://github.com/Morphan1/Depenizen/issues create a request] detailing the plugin name, where to find it, and what features are desired.
